summary_en: A quiet Sunday. skeletor-spaceman submitted two ERCs, Blob Space Segments and Blob Authenticated Messaging, letting several apps share one blob. Giulio2002 submitted an Engine API Communication Channels EIP. EliBenSasson explained native AA versus AA.
